descriptionMarkdown:
Tier does not hard-lock equipment. It describes what the campaign can usually support without exceptional story 
justification. A low-level character can carry a relic if the story gives them one; a high-level character can still be stuck 
with a battered lasgun after capture or disaster.
Tier Levels Normal Access Typical Exceptional Reward
Tier 1 1-4 Issued and Controlled gear. Scarce items appear 
as specialist mission assets.
One Scarce item, unusual modification, or limited-
use specialist ammunition.
Tier 2 5-10 Issued, Controlled and Scarce gear. Rare items 
become plausible rewards or difficult requisitions.
A Rare weapon, advanced augmetic, field or power 
weapon, or first master-crafted item.
Tier 3 11-16
Scarce gear is routine for established warbands; 
Rare equipment is attainable through strong faction 
access.
Exceptional armoury access, advanced master-
crafted gear, archeotech fragments or major 
faction-specific wargear.
Tier 4 17-20
Rare equipment can be expected around elite 
operatives. Exceptional gear remains politically and 
narratively important.
Exceptional or Near-Unique relic access tied to 
major obligations, patrons or campaign events.
